description: Source code for ApplicationDispmanx class managing window creation, input, and display on Raspberry Pi 4 within the Cobalt project.

classes.name: ApplicationDispmanx
classes.description: Class managing display, input, and window lifecycle for Raspberry Pi within Cobalt.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new window with given options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes audio sink and related components.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Cleans up resources and shuts down display components.

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles suspension, hides video element, and resets input.

methods.name: OnResume
methods.description: Resumes display and input after suspension.

methods.name: AcceptFrame
methods.description: Updates video renderer with new frame.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Checks if system events are available.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event with a timeout.

methods.name: InitializeDispmanx
methods.description: Initializes the Dispmanx display if not already initialized.

methods.name: ShutdownDispmanx
methods.description: Shuts down the Dispmanx display if initialized.
